expertise.title: Four domains, known from the inside.
expertise.body: Two decades of building for institutions concentrates into four fields where we know the regulations, the data and the daily reality — not just the technology.

items.name: Finance
items.short: Budget, revenue and registry systems for the state — and ERP platforms for banks. Software where every figure has to reconcile.
items.body: Public money leaves a long trail: budgets, tax collection, business registries, EU-fund execution. We have built and operated systems along that whole trail — from the Tax Administration's central registers to the contract-execution platform for EU assistance funds — and brought the same discipline to banking, where ERPStream runs on Oracle at ERSTE Bank.

items.name: Human Resources
items.short: HR and payroll platforms for the public sector — including the systems that manage the civil service and pay the country's pensions.
items.body: HR software for institutions is less about org charts and more about entitlements: careers, contributions, benefits — records that must stay correct for decades. We built the HR management information system of the Human Resources Management Authority and the national information system of the Pension & Disability Insurance Fund.

items.name: Healthcare
items.short: Information systems for health and social insurance — records, entitlements and claims, treated with the discretion medical data demands.
items.body: Health systems are where our domain disciplines meet: identity, entitlements, sensitive records and long institutional memory. We bring the same ISO-certified engineering and information-security practice that runs our public-sector platforms.

items.name: DMS & Workflow
items.short: Document management, registries and case workflows — InfoDMS and ERPStream carry the paper trail of ministries, parliament and the armed forces.
items.body: Institutions run on documents: filings, sessions, licences, official records. InfoDMS — deployed to NATO documentation standards at the Ministry of Defense — and the ERPStream workflow platform keep those records moving, traceable and permanent across government.

projects.title: Systems we've shipped.
projects.body: A few of the systems and tools we've built and run in production. Most of them power Montenegro's public institutions.

items.name: Official Gazette Legal Register
items.summary: Register of the refined, consolidated texts of Montenegro's laws and regulations for the Official Gazette, with full-text search across every published act.

items.name: DotBond
items.summary: An open-source toolchain our engineers built to generate fully-typed TypeScript clients from C#/.NET back-ends, keeping front-end and API contracts in lockstep.

items.name: Regulations Register
items.summary: Back-office register for classifying and publishing national regulations: issuer workflows, regulation metadata and EU-harmonisation chapter tracking.

items.name: Innovation Fund Platform
items.summary: The information system behind the Innovation Fund of Montenegro, managing funding programmes and applications, searchable by programme and year.

items.name: Register of NGOs & Political Parties
items.summary: Online registration and records for Montenegro's NGOs and political parties at ngo.gov.me: guided submission, seat and membership data, document issuance.

about.title: Built in Podgorica since 2004.
about.body1: Infostream is a privately held software company from Podgorica, Montenegro. For over two decades we have designed, built and operated enterprise systems for the institutions that run the country — tax, budget, pensions, defence — and for the banks that answer to them.
about.body2: Some sixty delivered projects across government and banking — built, run and answered for by the same team, year after year.
